51234414.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human 6X His-tagged KCTD12 T1 domain (27 to 131 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 DE3 cells assessed as dissociation constant by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.ITC Measurements: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) experiments were carried out in an ITC200 (Microcal/GE healthcare) in buffer containing 20 mM HEPES pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 5 mM β-ME. For the titration, 200 μM of peptides (1–3) in the syringe were injected into 20 μM of the protein (the concentration was calculated for tetramers of T1 domains of KCTD12) in the cell in a series of 13 injections with a first injection of 1 μL and the remaining 12 injections of 3 μL each. All titrations were carried out at 37 °C with a stirring speed of 1000 rpm. Control measurements of peptide versus buffer were carried out and subtracted from the peptide versus protein measurements. The data were analyzed with a one site binding model using the Nipic and SEDPHAT programs.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Figure 4. Affinity maturation of the GB2 C-terminal binding motif. (A) Design of the N- and C-terminal iterative peptide scans. The two best binding residues at each position in the 893–896 and 906–910 regions are included in separate N- and C-terminal iterative scans, respectively. (B) μSPOT-based dose–response curves of selected peptides from the iterative scan. (C) Comparison of relative EC50 values with FP-measured IC50 and calculated Ki values (mean ± s.e.m., n = 3) of the iterative scan and combined peptides. ns: not soluble. (D–E) ITC data showing titration of KCTD12T1 with peptide 1 (D) or peptide 3 (E). The top and the bottom sections report the raw and integrated data, respectively.
original_paragraph.Figure 4D and 4E data: Kd: 94.4 nM, ΔH: -10.0 kcal/mol, ΔS: -0.1 cal/mol·K (Figure 4D). Kd: 11.6 nM, ΔH: -13.6 kcal/mol, ΔS: -7.5 cal/mol·K (Figure 4E).

protein.name: recombinant human 6X His-tagged KCTD12 T1 domain (27 to 131 residues)

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 5 mM β-ME
assay_conditions.control_method: Control measurements of peptide versus buffer were carried out and subtracted from the peptide versus protein measurements.
